Pulse 0.15.2

What's new:
- Trade dates read back correctly for agents. A trade recorded in the app is dated at local midnight, but the MCP readback formatted it in UTC, so anyone east of Greenwich saw every trade one day early. Dates now read back in your time zone, record_trade and calibrate_position accept a plain YYYY-MM-DD, and the ledger orders same-day entries by when they were entered rather than by time of day, so a quick-set calibration no longer swallows a buy recorded later that day.
- One-click fills in the trade form. The live price and the sellable quantity sit beside their fields as small chips; one click drops the value in and hands focus back, so Return records the trade. The price that lands is the one at the moment of the click.
- Updates are easier to notice. When a new version is available, a red dot appears on the popover's "more" icon and "Check for Updates…" in that menu shows the version as a badge; the update window now carries the release notes in your language. Scheduled checks no longer interrupt you with an alert unless you just launched the app or the Mac has been idle.

No setup is required after updating. Existing watchlists, positions, and trade history are untouched.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.15.2.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
